description:
Port pi-tui natively to Elixir/OTP and wire Interactive mode into octo_pi_coder. Completes the pi-equivalent CLI on BEAM.

Scope (children to be created when we approach this phase):
- Raw-mode strategy decision (RESEARCH.md §7 Q5: stty vs /dev/tty Port vs termios NIF).
- Terminal port: raw mode in + SIGWINCH handling.
- Stdin buffer FSM: CSI/OSC/DCS/APC/SS3/meta detection, bracketed paste, 10ms timeout flush, Kitty query interception.
- Key parser: binary pattern matching for Kitty CSI u + legacy sequences.
- Differential renderer: line diff (O(n)), CSI 2026 atomic writes, overlay composite pre-diff, four full-redraw branches.
- Component behaviour + minimal Text/SelectList/Input.
- Editor component: kill ring, undo stack, slash/file autocomplete, wide-char aware wrap.
- Interactive mode glue in octo_pi_coder.

Definition of done: `mix pi` opens an interactive TUI, stream-rendering assistant turns with flicker-free updates and a working editor input.

Ref: RESEARCH.md §3.4, §8.2, §7 Q5, §6 Phase 4.
title: Phase 4: octo_pi_tui + Interactive mode
